name: Bookmarks' web UI end to end (since 1.1 with its editor, rows and section: the Name field first and focused, the Note a textarea, rows by their display title, 'My bookmarks (n)'): the details section, the editor (invalid input, add, edit), the delete confirmation, the player buttons, the B shortcut (its toast offers Name it since 1.1), the player bookmarks list and its seek, and the range button. Every step saves a normalised DOM snapshot (probes/dom-snapshot.js), so two runs, before and after a change, can be compared with compare-snapshots.mjs (against Bookmarks 1.0: --ignore-classes dialog,emby-input,emby-select-withcolor,button-submit --ignore-attrs aria-label,aria-labelledby,id, which leaves only 1.0's stray 'null' text in the delete confirmation; scripts/README.md). Resets the admin's bookmarks on Long Test Movie to two known ones first (sandbox data only).

steps.name: DOM snapshot helper in every document
find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: reset the movie's bookmarks to a point at 0:15 ('webcheck') and a range 0:30-0:40 ('webcheck-ui range')
steps.script: const itemId = __vars.movieId; const url = (p, q) => ApiClient.getUrl(p, q); for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: url('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } for (const body of [{ ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 150000000, Note: 'webcheck' }, { ItemId: itemId, StartTicks: 300000000, EndTicks: 400000000, Note: 'webcheck-ui range' }]) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: url('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(url('Bookmarks', { itemId }))).map(b => ({ StartTicks: b.StartTicks, EndTicks: b.EndTicks, Note: b.Note }));

steps.name: the Bookmarks section lists the two bookmarks
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); return !!s && !s.classList.contains('hide') && s.querySelector('h2').textContent === 'My bookmarks (2)' && s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row').length === 2; })()

steps.name: the Add bookmark button sits before the more-commands button
the section is the first child of the page content
open the editor with Add bookmark
the New bookmark editor, with the focus in its Name field
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'New bookmark' && document.activeElement === p.querySelector('input[maxlength="100"]'); })()

steps.name: the start is refused
steps.waitFor: document.querySelector('.jfbm-panel .jfbm-error').textContent === 'Enter the start as h:mm:ss, for example 1:02:03.5.'

steps.name: the editor closes and a toast confirms
open the delete confirmation of the new bookmark
steps.script: const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-ui created')); row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-actions button[title="Delete"]').click(); return true;

steps.name: the confirmation
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Delete bookmark?'; })()

steps.name: open the range bookmark's editor
steps.script: const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-row')].find(r => r.textContent.includes('webcheck-ui range')); row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-actions button[title="Edit"]').click(); return true;

steps.name: the Edit bookmark editor with the stored times, the note and the range length, Name focused
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Edit bookmark') return false; const v = [...p.querySelectorAll('input[type=text]')].map(i => i.value); return v[0] === '' && v[1] === '0:30.0' && v[2] === '0:40.0' && p.querySelector('textarea').value === 'webcheck-ui range' && p.querySelector('.jfbm-hint').textContent === 'Range length 0:10.0' && document.activeElement === p.querySelector('input[maxlength="100"]'); })()

steps.name: details page with a Play button
snapshot: player buttons and their neighbours
steps.eval: (() => { const add = document.querySelector('.videoOsdBottom .buttons .btnBookmarkAdd'); const buttons = [...add.parentElement.children]; const i = buttons.indexOf(add); return { buttons: [add, add.nextElementSibling, add.nextElementSibling.nextElementSibling].map(b => __domSnap(b)), next: (buttons[i + 3] && buttons[i + 3].className) || null }; })()

steps.name: the earlier toasts have gone (they last 4 s), so the next snapshot holds only B's
B created a bookmark, with a toast that offers Edit
the list dialog with three rows
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Bookmarks' && p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row').length === 3; })()

steps.name: the session plays at about 0:15 (Sessions API seek)
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const s = (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Sessions', { deviceId: ApiClient.deviceId() })))[0]; const p = s && s.PlayState && s.PlayState.PositionTicks; return typeof p === 'number' && p >= 140000000 && p < 250000000 ? p : false; })()

steps.name: the range toast and the active button
steps.waitFor: document.querySelector('.btnBookmarkRange').classList.contains('jfbm-active') && [...document.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-toast')].some(t => /^Range starts at \d+:\d\d\. Press the scissors again at the end\.Cancel$/.test(t.textContent))

steps.name: the editor opens with the range, Name focused
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'New bookmark') return false; const v = [...p.querySelectorAll('input[type=text]')].map(i => i.value); return v[0] === '' && document.activeElement === p.querySelector('input[maxlength="100"]') && /^\d+:\d\d\.\d$/.test(v[1]) && /^\d+:\d\d\.\d$/.test(v[2]) && /^Range length \d+:\d\d\.\d/.test(p.querySelector('.jfbm-hint').textContent) && !document.querySelector('.btnBookmarkRange').classList.contains('jfbm-active'); })()

steps.name: remove the bookmark made with B
steps.script: for (const b of await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))) { if (!b.Note) { await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'DELETE', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + b.Id, { deleteClip: 'true' }) }); } } return (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks', { itemId: __vars.movieId }))).length;

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, and jellyfin-web's own 'player cannot be null' when the player is left, excepted)
